placements.why: Establishes the strata category for system recovery procedures, drill cadences, and resilience verification.
placements.title: System recovery and operational resilience verification
placements.frame: How does the organization test and verify its fault isolation, recovery strategies, and operational resilience?

placements.title: Rollback capability requires regular rehearsal rather than passive assumption
placements.frame: How does routine operational rehearsal distinguish real recovery capabilities from untested assumptions?
placements.why: Frames the operational principle and policy directive that unrehearsed recovery pathways do not constitute genuine capability, necessitating scheduled monthly drills.
